subject: pharmacology
title: Antipsychotics: D2 blockade, EPS and clozapine

steps.tx: **Typical antipsychotics** (chlorpromazine, haloperidol; pure **D2 blockade**) control positive symptoms but hyperprolactinaemia (galactorrhoea, amenorrhoea, sexual dysfunction from tuberoinfundibular blockade) with **extrapyramidal symptoms** burden adherence; low potency sedates and hypotenses (alpha blockade) while high potency freezes. **Atypical antipsychotics** (serotonin-dopamine antagonism) spare EPS variably at metabolic cost. Depot decanoates (haloperidol, fluphenazine, paliperidone palmitate) enforce adherence in noncompliant psychosis.
steps.say: Pure D2 blocks psychosis and prolactin together: milky amenorrhoea with stiffness is typical. Depots enforce adherence.

steps.tx: **Atypical fingerprints** guide choice: **clozapine** (treatment resistant gold, **agranulocytosis** with weekly then monthly ANC, myocarditis, seizures, sialorrhea, no EPS, smoking induces CYP1A2 lowering levels on cessation), **olanzapine** (metabolic syndrome with diabetes), **quetiapine** (sedative, cataracts debated, bipolar depression), **risperidone** (prolactin raising), **ziprasidone** (QT prolonging, weight neutral), **aripiprazole** (partial D2 agonist, least metabolic, akathisia). Thioridazine (retinal deposits, QT) retired mostly.
steps.say: Resistant psychosis with ANC watched is clozapine. Metabolic weight is olanzapine; prolactin is risperidone.

steps.tx: **Extrapyramidal symptoms** time themselves: **acute dystonia** (hours to days, oculogyric crisis, **procyclidine or benztropine** rescue), **akathisia** (weeks, restless pacing, **propranolol** or benzodiazepines), drug induced **parkinsonism** (bradykinesia with rigidity, anticholinergics or amantadine, switch atypical), **tardive dyskinesia** (months to years, orofacial chorea, **valbenazine or deutetrabenazine** VMAT2, prevention by minimal dose). Rabbit syndrome (perioral tremor) mimics TD.
steps.say: Oculogyric hours after haloperidol is dystonia: procyclidine. Pacing weeks after is akathisia: propranolol.

steps.tx: **Neuroleptic malignant syndrome** (dopamine blockade: lead pipe rigidity with fever, autonomic instability, raised CK, delirium) is treated by **stopping drug with dantrolene or bromocriptine** and support; **QT prolongation** (thioridazine, ziprasidone, haloperidol IV) torsades needing ECG watched. **Clozapine** monitoring (ANC, myocarditis troponin, constipation ileus, nocturnal enuresis) sustains the resistant gold; re-challenge after neutropenia debates haematology. Smoking cessation doubles clozapine levels into toxicity.
steps.say: Rigid fever CK on antipsychotic is NMS: stop, dantrolene. Quitting smoking doubles clozapine: cut dose.
